name: B10-0149/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1822 authorising the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified maize DP915635 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to cancel its decision to allow a type of genetically modified maize, called DP915635, into the European Union for food and feed. The maize is engineered to survive spraying with glufosinate, a weedkiller banned in the European Union. Parliament says the approval should not stand, and that the Commission should stop approving crops built to tolerate banned weedkillers.

- Nothing changes yet: Parliament is asking the Commission to withdraw the maize approval.
- It affects farmers, food and feed importers, and shoppers in the European Union.
- Next, the Commission decides whether to withdraw its decision; Parliament cannot force it.
